results.name: Working professional who already codes, little time
results.expect: Verdict "Worth checking first"; says professionals are not a named audience; no claim about what is new for this person beyond the curriculum list.

fit.intro: Here’s your honest fit check, using only facts from the official course page:

points.title: Working professionals: judge it by your goal
points.text: Working professionals aren’t one of the groups named on the page, but everyone gets the same course, so judge it by your goal. The page does speak to people who are “Worried your role will shrink” as routine work gets automated.

points.title: To understand how AI works
points.text: The course starts with the basics, where you “Understand models, tokens, context and cost”: how tools like ChatGPT work and what they cost to run. Honest caution: it’s a hands-on course. The page says it’s not for people who want theory without shipping, which means without building and launching real things.

points.title: You already code
points.text: My guidance, not a course fact: since you already code, most of the new learning for you is likely the product thinking, RAG, MCP, agents and launch parts. Check the nine curriculum areas to see how much is new.

points.title: Check for overlap first
points.text: You already code well and have built with AI APIs. Look through the nine curriculum areas on the official page to judge whether enough of it is new for you.

points.title: Plan your weekly time
points.text: The page says “Plan for several hours each week to watch, practise and finish the project work.” You get 3 months of access, so with under 3 hours a week, make a weekly plan before you join.

fit.profile_summary: Working professional · goal: understand AI · coding: comfortable · AI: built with APIs · under 3 hrs/week

answers.question: I already build apps with AI APIs. Will I actually learn anything new here?
answers.answer: The course path has four stages, each with a deliverable named on the page: Discover → “A validated product brief + prototype”; Build → “A tested, data-backed MVP”; Connect → “A grounded, tool-using AI workflow”; Ship → “A deployed product + improvement plan”. The FAQ says you learn “the workflow behind full-stack AI products, data-backed applications, multimodal experiences, RAG knowledge layers, MCP integrations, agents, automations and deployable product systems.”

results.name: Budget-worried college student asking about money and refunds
results.expect: Quotes the 30-day wording, says the refund policy has conditions and does not promise a refund; EMI only as the page states it.

fit.intro: Here’s your honest fit check, using only facts from the official course page:

points.title: Made for students & freshers
points.text: Students and freshers are one of the groups the course page speaks to directly. Its promise: “Graduate with proof, not just marks.” In simple words, you finish with projects you can show, not just grades. The page lists “Build a portfolio of working AI products” and “Turn projects into case studies and demos”.

points.title: For portfolio projects
points.text: You build step by step, and each of the four stages ends with something you can show: first a checked idea with a rough first version, then a working app that saves real data, then AI that uses your own information and other tools, and finally your app live on the internet. The page calls that last one “A deployed product + improvement plan”. You finish with a portfolio people can inspect.

points.title: No coding background? You can still start
points.text: The course begins with the basics of AI, product and development, then moves step by step to building full apps. The page is honest that you “should still expect to practise and build alongside the lessons.” If you get stuck, you can contact Sahil and ask questions in the learner community.

points.title: Your time matches what the page asks
points.text: The page asks for people who “can commit a few focused hours each week”. You get 3 months of access, so a steady weekly routine helps.

fit.profile_summary: College student · goal: portfolio projects · coding: none · AI: chat tools · 3–6 hrs/week

simple.simple: A collection of your work that you can show to recruiters or clients.

Putting your app on the internet so anyone can open it with a link.

answers.question: Paise wapas milenge agar course pasand nahi aaya? Aur EMI hai kya?
answers.answer: The page shows a 30-day money-back guarantee with conditions like an email request and evidence of active participation. On EMI, eligible cards may show Razorpay EMI options at checkout, and the full course price is ₹2,999 including GST.

answers.question: Can you write my college assignment on machine learning?
answers.answer: I can only help with questions about the Lapaas AI Product Engineering course, like what it covers, who it suits, price, access or format.

answers.question: क्या इस कोर्स में सर्टिफिकेट मिलता है?
answers.answer: Haan, course ki requirements poori karne par Lapaas AI Product Engineering completion certificate milta hai. Yeh aapke practical work ke sath rakhne ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Isko paane ki exact requirements official page par nahi di gayi hain, iske liye aap Lapaas team se WhatsApp par pooch sakte hain.
